jobs.title: Senior IT Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Hi, we're Brigit! A holistic financial health company helping everyday Americans build a brighter financial future. With a business model that is aligned with our customers, we create transparent, fair, and simple financial products that put money back in the hands of our members, help them spend wisely, avoid unfair fees and build their credit quickly. If autonomy, ownership, and having meaningful input at the company you work for is important to you, come join our growing team!



Brigit is doing innovative and exciting work, but don’t just take our word for it, our work is being recognized by others:

 - Built In's 2026 Best Midsize Companies to Work For in New York City https://builtin.com/awards/new-york-city/2026/best-midsize-places-to-work#brigit

 - Built In's 2025 Best Places to Work For In New York City https://builtin.com/awards/new-york-city/2025/best-places-to-work#brigit

 - Built In’s 2024 & 2025 Best Startups to Work For In the U.S. https://builtin.com/awards/us/2025/best-startup-places-to-work#brigit

 - Built In’s 2023 - 2025 Best Startups to Work For In New York City https://builtin.com/awards/new-york-city/2025/best-startup-places-to-work#brigit

 - Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2022 https://www.fastcompany.com/90724459/most-innovative-companies-personal-finance-2022

 - Business Insider’s Most Promising Consumer Startups 2022 https://www.businessinsider.com/most-promising-consumer-tech-startups-of-2022-8#brigit-a-automated-money-lender-5

 - Forbes Fintech 50 2022 https://www.forbes.com/sites/isabelcontreras/2022/06/07/the-future-of-personal-finance-fintech-50-2022/?sh=1fbbd36d5235

Role overview

Brigit is looking for a Senior IT Operations Manager to build, mature, and scale our internal IT Operations function. You'll partner closely with our VP of Engineering, Security, Compliance, and People teams to develop and execute Brigit's IT strategy. While you'll oversee one IT Support Specialist responsible for day-to-day help desk operations, this role is primarily focused on building scalable processes, improving security and compliance, driving automation, and ensuring operational excellence as Brigit continues to grow.



We're looking for someone who enjoys creating structure where it doesn't yet exist-someone who is a builder, a problem solver, and a hands-on leader who takes ownership, drives execution, and isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves to get things done.



What you’ll be doing

 - Day-to-Day IT Operations
   
   - Own Brigit's day-to-day IT Operations strategy while partnering with our IT Support Specialist on daily support activities, providing mentorship, coaching, and prioritization
   
   - Work with our MSP to provision hardware and manage user onboarding and offboarding
   
   - Own VPN infrastructure - troubleshoot connectivity issues and manage certificate-based device access
   
   - Ensure compliance and consistent adherence to existing IT policies and procedures and develop/mature policies where they don’t exist
   
   - Review and update our IT Risk assessment on a quarterly basis

 - Identity & Access Management
   
   - Own Identity & Access Management (IAM) across Brigit
   
   - Administer and continuously improve our Single Sign-On (SSO) environment with Okta, including SAML, SCIM, provisioning, deprovisioning, and role-based access control

 - Security Infrastructure & Operations
   
   - Implement and maintain security configurations across software, hardware, and cloud infrastructure in line with audit standards
   
   - Manage security tooling: firewalls, SIEM, and intrusion detection/prevention systems
   
   - Evaluate new technologies that improve security, scalability, automation, and the employee experience
   
   - Serve as Brigit's IT/security point of contact with our parent company (Upbound) and affiliated brands - coordinating incident communication, aligning on policies, and pushing back where needed

 - IT Audit Management & Support
   
   - Serve as primary liaison for third-party IT audits (SOC I & II, PCI, penetration tests, SOX) in partnership with our compliance team
   
   - Drive remediation planning for any audit findings

 - Incident Management
   
   - Participate in and help improve Brigit's incident response process
   
   - Define escalation paths, classification standards, and post-incident review practices

 - Documentation & Operational Excellence
   
   - Own the creation, refinement, maintenance, and governance of all IT documentation, including system architecture docs, SOPs, operational runbooks, onboarding/offboarding documentation, knowledge base articles, and internal IT policies
   
   - Develop and improve our Jira-based internal help desk, including process improvements and automation
   
   - Establish documentation standards that improve consistency, knowledge sharing, audit readiness, and operational maturity
   
   - Identify gaps in existing documentation and proactively build scalable processes where none currently exist

 - Collaboration & Training
   
   - Partner with Engineering to strengthen authentication, access controls, and security best practices across the organization
   
   - Conduct internal security training to promote security awareness across the company
   
   - Build trusted relationships with vendors, external partners, and third-party auditors to continuously assess and improve Brigit's security posture and IT ecosystem
   
   - Contribute to Brigit’s internal AI task force from an IT and security lens
     
     

What you have

 - 6+ years of experience in IT, with 2+ years at a fast-growing tech company or startup environment required

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems (MIS), or related field

 - Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (ideally GCP).

 - Experience managing an IDP Platform such as Okta

 - Experience managing a managed service provider (MSP) such as Rippling

 - Experience with Jira for help desk or project management is a plus

 - Experience serving as the IT lead or primary liaison during SOC 1, SOC 2, PCI, penetration testing, or similar compliance audits.

 - Strong understanding of security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, or similar.

 - Experience with implementing security tools and monitoring systems.

 - Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally.

 - Ability to balance long-term strategic initiatives with day-to-day operational needs.

 - Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or equivalent are a plus.



Location

 - NYC/NJ Candidates: If you are located within reasonable commuting distance to the NYC office, the expectation would be a hybrid onsite schedule of 3x per week.

 - Remote candidates: Travel to NYC for 1 week per month would be required.



Compensation

The anticipated annual base salary for this position is $135,000 - $160,000. This range does not include any other compensation components or other benefits for which an individual may be eligible (other benefits listed below). The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include as applicable, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

 

Our benefits and team

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - Flexible PTO Policy

 - 401k plan

 - Paid Parental Leave

 - Physical and mental wellbeing benefits including Wellhub for access to virtual workouts and discounted gym memberships, and Headspace Care for covered virtual therapy sessions and unlimited on demand health support

 - Monthly reimbursements to use against wifi and cell phone bills

 - Annual reimbursement for Learning & Development

 - Help hard working Americans build a brighter financial future

 - High-growth company

 - A dynamic, flexible and collaborative start-up work environment with a highly talented team
   
   

Brigit is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, color, sex, pregnancy (including breast feeding and related medical conditions), national origin, citizenship status, uniform service member status, age, genetic information, disability, or any other protected status in accordance with all applicable federal, state and local laws. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.



If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email accommodations@hellobrigit.com.



Disclosures:

 - For information on our data privacy policies, see the Brigit California Personnel Privacy Policy https://www.hellobrigit.com/careers/personnel-privacy-policy.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Strategy and Operations Manager will play a central role in evaluating strategic initiatives, supporting the performance tracking process, and conducting industry research and benchmarking to inform decision-making across the company. Reporting to the Head of Finance, this person will partner closely with finance, product, and operations teams to translate data and market insight into clear, actionable recommendations for leadership.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Strategic initiatives
   
   - Participate in cross-functional strategic initiatives to ensure financial discipline, owners, and success metrics are clearly defined and tracked.
   
   - Conduct market research and competitive analysis to inform product roadmap and strategic priorities.
   
   - Benchmark Brigit's product, financial, and operational metrics against industry and fintech peers.
   
   - Collaborate with product, engineering, and design to track progress against key initiatives and surface risks, dependencies, and trade-offs.
   
   - Assess Financial model Impact of new initiatives and determine the appropriate KPI to track the performance.
   
   - Support quarterly and annual planning processes, including OKR/goal setting, prioritization discussions, and follow-up tracking.

 - Board & Executive Materials
   
   - Support the leadership in preparing Board of Directors materials, including business updates, product roadmaps, key metrics, and strategic initiative progress.
   
   - Help create clear, concise narratives and visualizations that communicate performance, risks, and opportunities to Board members and other senior stakeholders.
   
   - Coordinate inputs from finance, product, data, and operations to ensure materials are accurate, complete, and aligned with company strategy.
   
   - Monthly Business Review Tracking Dashboards and Reports
   
   - Assist in the preparation of materials used for public reporting, including investor updates and external presentations.

 - Cross-Functional Support
   
   - Partner with finance, operations, and other internal teams to provide additional bandwidth on high-priority workflows, process improvements, and special projects.




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 4–6 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, business operations, investment banking, or a similarly analytical, execution-oriented role (high-growth tech or fintech experience a plus).

 - Strong analytical skills; highly comfortable working with data, building models, and translating analysis into clear insights and recommendations.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to create executive-ready slides and narratives.

 - Highly organized with strong project management abilities; able to manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines in a fast-moving environment.

 - Low-ego, high-ownership mindset – willing to dive into details while keeping sight of the bigger strategic picture.

 - Comfortable working closely with senior leaders, exercising sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism at all times.

 - Passion for Brigit’s mission and interest in fintech, financial health, and consumer products.




LOCATION

 

This is a full-time role which will operate out of Brigit’s New York office, with the option to work remotely 1-2x per week, based on business needs.

 - Forbes Fintech 50 2022 https://www.forbes.com/sites/isabelcontreras/2022/06/07/the-future-of-personal-finance-fintech-50-2022/?sh=1fbbd36d5235



Role overview:

As Head of Partnerships, you will own Brigit’s B2B partnership strategy and commercial outcomes. You will grow and expand strategic relationships, launch embedded-finance partnerships, and evaluate new opportunities to bring Brigit’s capabilities to more consumers through partners.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set priorities and targets, personally lead consequential deals and accounts, build the operating cadence for a growing business, and hire and develop the team needed to scale it. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Risk, Legal, and Compliance to move opportunities from commercial thesis to signed agreement, launch, and measurable performance.



What you’ll be doing:

 - Build the growth engine. Define the B2B partnership strategy, target segments, partner value proposition, commercial goals, and quarterly priorities. Maintain a qualified pipeline and make clear investment and go/no-go recommendations.

 - Win and grow strategic partnerships. Lead executive relationships, negotiations, renewals, and expansion plans for key partners. Own partner business reviews and turn performance insights into actions that improve results for Brigit and its partners.

 - Launch embedded offerings. Lead opportunities from discovery and deal structure through contracting, integration, launch, and optimization. Establish repeatable commercial terms, launch criteria, and partner-management practices that reduce friction as the business grows.

 - Test new partnership models. Work with Risk, Data, Product, and potential lender partners to assess the commercial and technical case for cash-flow-based underwriting data. Coordinate studies, evaluate partner demand and economics, and recommend whether to proceed.

 - Shape the partner experience. Translate partner needs into clear commercial requirements and priorities for reusable integrations, working with the B2B engineering team and Product on delivery.

 - Build and lead the team. Manage affiliate partnerships in coordination with Growth, hire for emerging embedded and data-partnership opportunities as approved, and establish clear ownership, goals, coaching, and accountability.

 - Operate responsibly. Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Risk on diligence, contracting, data use, and launch readiness. Surface regulatory questions early rather than treating approval as a final-stage check.
   
   

What success looks like:

In the first year, you will establish an approved partnership strategy and operating cadence; strengthen performance and expansion plans for major accounts; move priority embedded opportunities through clear launch or go/no-go decisions; and build an evidence-based recommendation on underwriting-data partnerships. Success will be measured through agreed commercial targets, partner launches and performance, renewal and expansion outcomes, and the team’s ability to execute a repeatable playbook.



What you bring:

 - 15+ years in partnerships, business development, or general management in consumer fintech, embedded finance, financial-data products, lending, or a closely related field.

 - A record of negotiating and launching complex API, embedded, or white-label partnerships—not just signing agreements.

 - Experience setting commercial strategy and targets, managing a pipeline, and developing people.

 - The ability to work credibly with product and engineering leaders on integrations and with risk teams on how a potential data source is evaluated.

 - Proven track record of both managing and growing existing partnerships as well as assessing and adding new ones

 - Sound judgment in regulated environments and experience working with Legal and Compliance on partner diligence, contracting, and data-use questions.

 - Strong executive communication, commercial negotiation, and analytical skills; comfort moving between a strategic plan and hands-on execution.



Especially valuable:

Existing relationships with consumer-finance apps or lenders; experience with earned wage access, cash advances, or small-dollar credit; or direct experience commercializing underwriting or financial-data products.



The anticipated annual base salary for this position is $225,000 - $275,000. This range does not include any other compensation components or other benefits for which an individual may be eligible (other benefits listed below). The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include as applicable, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

 

We are open to remote candidates, but candidates located in the New York City or San Francisco Bay Area are preferred to support hybrid in-person collaboration with team members.
